name: Source
description: Acoustic Source object (speaker, human, etc.). Choose its directivity on the body: omnidirectional (default), cardioid, supercardioid, hypercardioid or bidirectional; and, optionally, its anechoic sound on the Anechoic sound dropdown, which Auralise then uses for this source in place of its own.

inputParameters.name: spl
inputParameters.description: The source's level: the sound pressure level on its axis at 1 m in free field, in dB, per octave band 125 Hz to 8 kHz (7 values) or one value for every band. Empty: 120 dB. The SPL of Analyse Impulse Response reads from it.

inputParameters.name: sound
inputParameters.description: Anechoic sound of the source: Auralise convolves the responses of this source with it, in place of the sound chosen on Auralise. On the Anechoic sound dropdown: one of the bundled anechoic recordings, or Load... to choose a sound file (.wav, .flac, .aiff, .ogg, .mp3), which the dropdown then lists by its name; nothing is chosen by default, and the dropdown reads '...': Auralise's sound is then used. A File Path connected here takes precedence.
